recommendationBeforeApplyingBatch1A.founderQuestionAnswer: No — the current Brand Explorer Active-62 validation process does not review all Brand Setup fields. It primarily reviews Brand Basics governance/status fields used for universe + footnote, and Brand Explorer Presentation owner-facing text (Title/Body/Case Summary*). Other Brand Setup child tables (Footprint, Fee Structure, Standards, Deal Terms, Project Fit, etc.) are outside Active-62 gates.
